rules.statement: A co-owner is not entitled to maintain an action for a declaration of title to a building standing on the common property.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right of the builder is limited to a claim for compensation, which he could enforce in a partition action under sections 2 and 5 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1853."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 2 and 5 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1853
